title: I made a 3D Snake game with Claude Code for the Slapjam AI Game Jam
author: Kooky-Audience-2291
selftext:
I made **Cubic Snake: Castle** for the Slapjam AI Game Jam.

The idea, game design, creative direction and playtesting were done by me. I used **Claude Code** to build the game in **three.js**, including the code and 3D models.

One interesting part was turning classic Snake movement into something that works across the different sides of a 3D castle, including gates and windows that act as shortcuts.

Would be interested in feedback, especially on the gameplay and controls:

[https://itch.io/jam/slapjam-ai-1/rate/5075897](https://itch.io/jam/slapjam-ai-1/rate/5075897)
